letterText: Some journeys begin on winding mountain roads with cold wind against our faces.
Some journeys take us through crowded airport terminals, early morning flights, and tearful goodbyes.
Through every kilometre, every flight, every late-night call, and every silent countdown...
My heart never left your side.
Thank you for being my co-rider, my travel partner, my best friend, and my favourite person in every city and every sky.
closingLine: No matter where the road goes next...
